question: Thiyam Suryamukhi Devi who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards 2003, is known for her contribution to the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri dance**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Thiyam Suryamukhi Devi** received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2003 for her outstanding contribution to **Manipuri dance**.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is the highest recognition given to practicing artists in India.
 
• Manipuri dance
